verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs explicitly describe liveness detection matching the live applicant to their account/documents and confirm defenses against deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, and photos of a screen, directly addressing spoofing via printed photos and screen replays. Liveness & Face match is documented as part of verification levels, and reviewers can inspect results per applicant. Missing for 10: explicit mention of replayed video attacks specifically, and independent/third-party test results validating anti-spoofing accuracy claims.
